scenes.vo: Vouch, week three. What we built, what we learned, what's next.

scenes.head: Built: the full flow, live through the UI
scenes.sub: A $20 brand-identity job: locked, delivered, verified 5 of 5, paid. Tempo testnet, every step on-chain.
scenes.vo: Built: the product redesign shipped, and the whole flow ran live through the UI. A client locks twenty dollars, the designer delivers, the verifier passes five of five, the client approves, and the pay lands. Then Base, funded with x402, and private payouts into a Tempo Zone.

scenes.label: Learned
scenes.head: Judged against the rubric, three gaps.

bullets.v: The pitch now opens with who I am and my sister Rita, the freelancer who was never paid.
Pitch 2:54; the Tempo depth moved into a 2:55 technical demo.
Fifteen funded $5 test-money jobs are out; zero logged testers yet.

scenes.vo: Learned: I judged the submission against Colosseum's own criteria and found three gaps. The pitch had no team and ran four minutes; it now opens with me and my sister Rita, under three minutes, with a separate technical demo. And it has no users yet: fifteen funded test jobs are out, and no one has delivered.
